A '''Laser array''' was a type of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapon that projected bursts of particle beam energy. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Scabrous]]' [[Darth Scabrous' HK droid|HK droid]] was equipped with a pair of augmented laser arrays.<ref name="Red Harvest" />
